label: GreenPilot gateway
info: Plays the Raspberry Pi gateway: links the ESP32 field node (WebSocket) to the cloud broker (MQTT v5 over TLS).

name: Startup
info: Loads the default configuration. Values pushed by the cloud (UPDATE_CONFIG) are kept in the context store.

info: Messages are kept in the persistent context store while the broker is unreachable, then sent again in order. The backend ignores duplicates thanks to the msgId.

name: Uplink

info: Checks each command (duplicate, expiry, field node online, reservoir, duration) before forwarding it to the ESP32. Rejections are acknowledged straight away.
